PLAYER CONTROLS

Hold a direction to move. Press your bomb key to place a water bomb.

MATCH SETTINGS

1 · Set up the match

Mobile mode: hold the direction pad to move, tap BOMB with your other thumb. Portrait or landscape supported.

Correct answer = 1 star. Reach the target to win immediately. Unlimited question time still follows the match clock.

2 · Choose question topics

Teacher: tick the topics you want to practise.

3 · Choose your teachers

Each player uses a different teacher. Match your player number to the player controls guide.

How to play & scoring

P1 / Solo: arrows + Enter. P2: W/S/A/D + Q. P3: T/G/F/H + R. P4: I/K/J/L + U. Each group is up/down/left/right + bomb. Escape pauses.

No hearts. A wrong answer or water blast knocks you out for this question. Watch the hurt animation, then return at your starting corner when the next question begins. Only knocked-out players return to their starting corners. Survivors stay in place; old bombs and blasts are cleared. A, B and C move to new reachable tiles every question. The first correct answer starts the next question immediately. If everyone is out, or time runs out, reveal the answer before continuing.

Correct: +1 star, +100 points and a random 30-second ability. Wrong: out this question and −25 points. Stars and abilities are kept. Reach the star target to win; at match timeout, stars decide the winner, with points breaking ties. Being the last player standing does not end the match.

SOLO is one human versus one computer. The CPU thinks for 5–8 seconds, chooses an answer (72% accuracy), walks to a portal, dodges bombs and can plant bombs. It uses a different teacher and cannot be controlled with P2 keys. Falling bombs remain optional.

Keyboard hardware may limit simultaneous keys. Try each player's controls before a class match. Solo also has on-screen buttons.
